content.agent_verified: The target server compiled this snapshot.
content.agent_stale: The server result is for an older draft snapshot.
content.mock: Replayed from a stored fixture, not a live compiler.
content.local: Composed in the browser from the draft.

metrics.from_mounted_assets: Advances derived from the mounted resource pack.
metrics.from_artifact: Advances read from the metrics artifact generated from the client jar.
metrics.incomplete: At least one font could not be measured.

wrapping.agent: Line breaks decided by the production layout engine.
wrapping.browser_greedy: Greedy line breaking in the browser, using real pixel advances.

raster.mounted: Drawn from the mounted glyph textures. GPU sampling and rounding may still differ from the client.
raster.partial: Some glyphs have metrics but no pixels.
raster.no_assets: No glyph textures mounted, so nothing can be drawn faithfully.

frame.sprites_mounted: Nine-sliced from the mounted tooltip sprites.
frame.sprites_missing: The theme requests a tooltip style the mounted packs do not provide.
frame.legacy_gradient: Drawn with the pre-sprite gradient because no tooltip sprite is mounted.

icon.flat_sprite: Flat item sprite resolved from the mounted assets.
icon.block_model: This item uses a 3D block model, which this preview does not render.

positioning.client_decides: GUI scale, window size, and screen-edge flipping are decided by the player's client.

vanilla_lines.preserved: The client adds its own enchantment and attribute lines, which this preview does not show.
vanilla_lines.managed: The theme claims every tooltip line, so the client should add none.
